scripts.package: rm -rf migration-lambda.zip .lambda-build && mkdir -p .lambda-build && cp -r dist/* .lambda-build/ && echo '{"dependencies":{"@aws-sdk/client-secrets-manager":"^3.700.0","pg":"^8.11.3"}}' > .lambda-build/package.json && cd .lambda-build && npm install --production --no-package-lock && rm -f package.json package-lock.json && zip -r ../migration-lambda.zip . && cd .. && rm -rf .lambda-build || true
